## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
CAUTION. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: positive sector breadth vs. clear weakness in Technology and Financials (conflicting signals), and major cross-asset divergences among large caps—hence CAUTION. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5).

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Energy leads: OXY (1W: +13.08% | 1M: +17.80%) ABOVE TREND; XOM (1W: +2.10% | 1M: +11.32%) ABOVE TREND. Materials strong: FCX (1W: +11.11% | 1M: +12.37%) ABOVE TREND; NUE (+70 sentiment) showing strength. Industrials: DE (1W: +7.27% | 1M: +25.29%) ABOVE TREND; GE (1W: +5.67% | 1M: +17.62%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Technology lagging: MSFT (1W: -1.76% | 1M: -16.32%) BELOW TREND; INTU (1W: -5.40% | 1M: -36.40%) BELOW TREND. Financials lagging overall: JPM (1W: -3.20% | 1M: -0.14%) BELOW TREND; V (1W: -3.84% | 1M: -5.62%) BELOW TREND. Real Estate also soft on 1W.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: PYPL (1W: +15.22% | 1M: -16.96%) RECOVERY; OXY (1W: +13.08% | 1M: +17.80%) ABOVE TREND; FCX (1W: +11.11% | 1M: +12.37%) ABOVE TREND; DE (1W: +7.27% | 1M: +25.29%) ABOVE TREND; GE (1W: +5.67% | 1M: +17.62%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5); style leaning Value/Cyclical.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: PANW (1W: -13.35% | 1M: -21.37%) BELOW TREND; IBM (1W: -11.22% | 1M: -21.14%) BELOW TREND; ACN (1W: -10.53% | 1M: -30.01%) BELOW TREND; INTU (1W: -5.40% | 1M: -36.40%) BELOW TREND; UNH (1W: -5.24% | 1M: -23.10%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in high-multiple Technology and select Financial/Healthcare names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Best 1W momentum: PYPL (1W: +15.22% | 1M: -16.96%) RECOVERY; OXY (1W: +13.08% | 1M: +17.80%) ABOVE TREND; FCX (1W: +11.11% | 1M: +12.37%) ABOVE TREND. Watch major divergences: AMD (1W: +5.30% | 1M: -17.65%) RECOVERY and GOOGL (1W: +2.94% | 1M: -5.19%) RECOVERY — tactical volatility, not confirmation of broad uptrend.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Mixed-to-weak: ASML (1W: +5.50% | 1M: +7.97%) ABOVE TREND and AMAT (1W: +5.37% | 1M: +17.38%) ABOVE TREND offset by MSFT (1W: -1.76% | 1M: -16.32%) BELOW TREND, INTU (1W: -5.40% | 1M: -36.40%) BELOW TREND and IBM (1W: -11.22% | 1M: -21.14%) BELOW TREND; sector 1W: -1.10% (Technology weak).

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Patchy: CME (1W: +5.21% | 1M: +12.84%) ABOVE TREND and PYPL (1W: +15.22% | 1M: -16.96%) RECOVERY are outperforming while JPM (1W: -3.20% | 1M: -0.14%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -3.84% | 1M: -5.62%) BELOW TREND and MA (1W: -4.58% | 1M: -5.10%) BELOW TREND weigh on the group; Financials 1W: -1.89% (Financials weak).

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Neutral-to-cautious: JNJ (1W: +1.21% | 1M: +11.87%) ABOVE TREND and MRK news (+60) supportive, vs UNH (1W: -5.24% | 1M: -23.10%) BELOW TREND and LLY (1W: +0.59% | 1M: -1.92%) RECOVERY; sector 1W: +0.05% (Healthcare mixed).

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor cyclicals/value exposure (OXY, DE, FCX, GE) and monitor PYPL for deal flow-driven continuation; reduce exposure to high-multiple Tech names showing chart breakdowns (ACN, INTU, IBM, PANW) and to Financials with broad weakness (JPM, V, MA). Style: Value/Cyclical favored within a CAUTION regime.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: PYPL (1W: +15.22% | 1M: -16.96%) RECOVERY — M&A chatter (+85) confirming 1W strength; OXY (1W: +13.08% | 1M: +17.80%) ABOVE TREND — energy tailwinds; FCX (1W: +11.11% | 1M: +12.37%) ABOVE TREND — operational extension news (+65).  
BEARISH: UNH (1W: -5.24% | 1M: -23.10%) BELOW TREND — negative guidance/sentiment (-55); ACN (1W: -10.53% | 1M: -30.01%) BELOW TREND — tech cuts; PANW (1W: -13.35% | 1M: -21.37%) BELOW TREND — momentum breakdown.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +2.70%) and Materials (1W: +1.01%) on commodity/operational catalysts.  
BEARISH: Technology (1W: -1.10%) and Financials (1W: -1.89%) given leadership cracks and guidance risks.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
NVDA (1W: +4.26% | 1M: +2.76%) ABOVE TREND — watch for hold above recent swing highs for continuation.  
AAPL (1W: +3.13% | 1M: +9.82%) ABOVE TREND — watch break/hold of the 1M breakout zone for broader Tech sentiment.  
OXY (1W: +13.08% | 1M: +17.80%) ABOVE TREND — follow consolidation above latest breakout as energy confirmation.  
UNH (1W: -5.24% | 1M: -23.10%) BELOW TREND — failure to reclaim near-term support would deepen Healthcare downside.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
PYPL (+85): Stripe takeover chatter; price RECOVERY (1W: +15.22% | 1M: -16.96%) — sentiment confirmed by large 1W spike.  
WMT (+85): Buyback and e‑commerce strength; price CORRECTION (WMT 1W: -1.63% | 1M: +7.66%) — positive news vs short-term pullback (watch follow-through).  
ASML (+65): EUV breakthrough; price ABOVE TREND (ASML 1W: +5.50% | 1M: +7.97%) — sentiment confirmed.  
FCX (+65): Grasberg extension; price ABOVE TREND (FCX 1W: +11.11% | 1M: +12.37%) — sentiment confirmed.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
UNH (-55): Weak guidance headline; price BELOW TREND (UNH 1W: -5.24% | 1M: -23.10%) — sentiment confirmed.  
LLY (-60): Novo Nordisk price cuts news; price RECOVERY (LLY 1W: +0.59% | 1M: -1.92%) — divergence between news and small 1W lift, monitor.  
ADBE (-50): Analyst concerns; price not in top movers but sector risk persists — if ADBE weakens further it would pressure Tech.  
TSLA (-50): Europe sales slump; price BELOW TREND (TSLA 1W: -0.30% | 1M: -8.84%) — confirmation of regional demand risk.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION, Value/Cyclical style favored as sector breadth is positive but leadership is conflicted between cyclicals and faltering Tech/Financials. OXY (1W: +13.08% | 1M: +17.80%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +11.11% | 1M: +12.37%) ABOVE TREND and PYPL (1W: +15.22% | 1M: -16.96%) RECOVERY are showing relative strength. Key risk: clustered Tech/Financial breakdowns and mixed news flow (UNH negative, PYPL takeover chatter) — watch for trend confirmation before adding risk.
